ratchetRule: V4 preserves one server semantic authority. Oggi, Processi and Prove are projections over the same runtime state. Enterprise Compliance Nexus and Process Landscape are presentation projections only; browser surfaces consume routing, work queue, procedure guides, review inbox, deterministic insights, decision, epistemic and evidence projections and may not create authority locally.
limitations: V4 Experimental · Enterprise Nexus means coherent experimental product use, not production readiness, certification or legal compliance.
The seven business processes remain directly openable without AI routing; routing is deterministic assistance and always requires human selection.
AI OFF preserves business-process availability and manual workflow entry; AI ON adds proposals only and cannot become organizational decision authority.
Coverage is bounded to the declared universe and heatmap values require human-reviewed risk ratings, preferring residual assessment when available.
Execution of remediation and verified closure are distinct checkpoints; closure requires human verification and evidence references.
AI insight narratives cannot modify KPI, work queue, heatmap or decisions and require human validation against the same deterministic basis.
Deployment readiness remains bounded by explicit external controls and attestations.
